title: Lutt Gaye Alay Muhammad Kay Ghaaranay Walay
body:
Taarsay Paani Ko Bhi Kausar Kay Lutanay Walay (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hogayi Shaam Inhain Shaam Kay Bazaaraon Main (x2)
Aik Beemar Ko Laakhon Hain Sataanay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani Tujh Ko Na Milla Hay Meray Mazloom Hussain (x2)
Tashnagi Khanjar-e-Zalim Ki Bhujanay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Azm-e-Shabbir Ko Dekha Toh Pukar Uthay Khalil (x2)
Marhaba Lasha-e-Akbar Ko Uthanay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro Kay Kehti Thi Sakina Meray Aamu Hay Kahan (x2)
Laut Kaar Aaye Nahin Paani Pilaanay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolli Zainab Woh Giri Khaak Pay Tasveer-e-rasool (x2)
Chal Basay Yaad Bhi Nana Kay Dillanay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hurr Ki Taqdeer Ko Aik Pal May Badal Daytay Hain (x2)
Aisay Hotay Hain Mohammed Kay Ghaaranay Walay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Kehti Bakshwaa Lungi Unhain Mehshar Main (x2)
Jo Meray Laal Pai Aansoo Hain Bahanay Walay.
